preconditions.description: Attacker must be authorized (owner or authorized address) to call blacklistAddress function

exploit_hint: As an authorized address, call the blacklistAddress function with a victim's address and set _value to true. This will prevent the victim from making any transfers (buy/sell) by causing the _transferFrom function to revert with 'Address is blacklisted' error. The attack demonstrates improper access control where authorized users can arbitrarily block any address from transacting.
